rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Sunny Sky ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tim Hermann Kordes (Germany, 1999).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 2009 as 'Sunny Sky'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow, darker center. Mild, apple, apricot or peach, lemon, sweet fragrance. up to 45 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Armed with thorns / prickles, bushy, upright. Semi-glossy, medium green foliage. 5 leaflets.

Height: up to 47" (up to 120cm). Width: up to 28" (up to 70cm).
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Disease susceptibility: very blackspot resistant., mildew resistant.
rows.Patents:
United States - Patent No: PP 22,352 on 20 Dec 2011 VIEW USPTO PATENT
Application No: 12/925,242 on 14 Oct 2010
The new variety of rose plant of the present invention originated from a controlled crossing in a breeding program of two distinct parents during the summer of 1999. The crossing was between an unnamed seedling and another unnamed seedling.

fragrance: Mild, apple, apricot or peach, lemon, sweet fragrance.
